Maya (eng-runtime): Heads-up — our prefix cache hit-rate for model gpt-small-v2 dropped ~18 percentage points in the EU cluster starting ~11:28 UTC. Token-saved rate dipped ~70k tokens/min. Grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc123/prefix-hitline (screenshot in thread).

Liam (eng-ml): interesting — any recent changes to keying or normalization?

Maya (eng-runtime): not on intented keying. Last night we pushed kernel-3.2.1 (perf kernels + batching heuristics) to canary. runtime-deploy-bot shows rollout at 11:20.

runtime-deploy-bot: deploy completed: kernel-3.2.1 -> canary (rollout id: r-2026-03-15-1120). :white_check_mark:

Chris (eng-infra): can you paste the query you used for the per-customer slice? want to repro the delta.

Maya (eng-runtime): sure — sample promql we used: ```
sum by(customer_id) (rate(prefix_cache_hits_total{model="gpt-small-v2",region="eu"}[5m]))
/
sum by(customer_id) (rate(prefix_cache_requests_total{model="gpt-small-v2",region="eu"}[5m]))
```

Maya (eng-runtime): also looked at token-saved: ```
sum(rate(tokens_saved_total{model="gpt-small-v2",region="eu"}[1m]))
```

Liam (eng-ml): a few hypotheses:
- kernel change accidentally changed canonicalization of trailing whitespace when batching identical prefixes -> key mismatch.
- batching heuristic started merging prompts differently so prefix chunking differs -> fewer cache hits.
- KV cache warmup path might be skipping prefetch for small sequences.

Sophia (eng-sre): we should check rollout vs customer impact correlation. I can run a quick join: grafana->bigquery event table, match deploy id -> customer hit-rate drop.

Chris (eng-infra): quick check: list of model variants that map to same cache namespace? If kernel introduced a model_id string change (e.g., removed suffix) keys could namespace-shift.

Maya (eng-runtime): i ran a diff on cache-key fingerprints for one heavy customer: many keys that used to fingerprint to X now hash to X:f (extra char). looks like a normalization change. snippet: ```
# before
fingerprint("user_prompt_v1:...::model=gpt-small-v2") -> 0x7a3f
# after
fingerprint("user_prompt_v1:...:f:model=gpt-small-v2") -> 0x2b8c
```

Liam (eng-ml): that aligns with the trailing-token normalization change we added to batching to preserve stop-token contexts. bug might have introduced an extra delimiter.

Sophia (eng-sre): Can we roll back canary quickly while we triage? impact looks isolated to eu canary nodes (not global yet).

Chris (eng-infra): rollback initiated for canary group eu-canary-nodes. runtime-deploy-bot should post status.

runtime-deploy-bot: rollback started: kernel-3.2.1 -> previous (rollout id: r-2026-03-15-1120) :warning:

Maya (eng-runtime): after rollback I see hit-rate climbing back toward baseline in the sample customers — +12pp in 6 minutes. token-saved trending up. good signal.

Liam (eng-ml): action items:
- revert the normalization change in batching kernel; add unit test for key canonicalization (whitespace/trailing delimiter).
- add a regression alert: per-customer prefix hit-rate drop >10pp for 5m after deploy -> automated rollback.
- augment observability: store fingerprint diffs per-deploy for top-100 customers for first 10 minutes.

Maya (eng-runtime): +1 on fingerprint diffs. for dashboards: create a per-route panel that shows tokens_saved_delta_by_deploy and key_mismatch_rate. suggest PromQLs and a small table in console.

Chris (eng-infra): I'll add deploy metadata (rollout id, kernel version) to prefix cache metrics so we can slice in grafana.

Sophia (eng-sre): follow-up: run a profile on kv-cache warmup path with representative inputs to ensure prefetch isn't skipped when batcher shape changes. I can schedule CPU/GPU profiler run.

Maya (eng-runtime): will open a short PR with the test + revert candidate. tagging @Liam for review. PR: https://git/redwood/runtime/pull/4821

Liam (eng-ml): on it. also we should add a small synthetic traffic test in canary that asserts stable cache hit-rate vs baseline (>=95% of baseline) for first 15 minutes post-deploy.

Maya (eng-runtime): noted. will create monitoring runbook steps and update the prefix-cache dashboard with a canary overlay.

Chris (eng-infra): rollback complete. runtime-deploy-bot: rollback finished successfully. :white_check_mark:

runtime-deploy-bot: rollback completed: r-2026-03-15-1120 -> previous.

Maya (eng-runtime): thanks all — marking this thread resolved for now. will post postmortem if root-cause repros in integration. :thumbsup:
